name: Harrowed World: Dracula Fallen
summary:
Dracula has been resurrected in modern nights Los Angeles. Separated from his home by oceans and time itself, he must come to grips with a new world while his survival hangs in the balance.

Harrowed World: Dracula Fallen is a work of interactive horror fiction offering a quiet descent into the dark. No music stirs, no voices speak, no light intrudes. You are left alone with only the text and the echoes from the dark recesses of your mind.

The New Order of the Dragon has brought Dracula back from his second death with a long-forgotten ritual from the forbidden tomes of Scholomance but things are not all that they seem.

In Hollywood, yet another adaption of Bram Stoker’s novel is being made, and Dracula must come to terms with the unexpected fame that the author has bestowed upon him.
